scope: Preparation of the two larger-backbone candidates against the same private failure case, retaining both base candidates and V6 as comparisons. Identifying plans, source text, binding manifests and scores remain in private Studio storage.
v6_replay_scope: The original V6 reports contain direct whole-text observations; original window diagnostics were not scored. Exact replay does not add missing V6 window observations. Candidate execution must follow the complete-request protocol.
preparation_correction: The first preflight expected tokenizer files as direct public-plan binding keys. It stopped before writing a plan or running the document reporter. The corrected preparation verifies tokenizers through the already-bound checkpoint manifests. Both attempts are retained; no source or expected hash changed.
limitations: No fitted candidate was evaluated. This does not establish detector quality, Pangram alignment, gradient usefulness, Linux qualification or readiness to resume B optimization.
